capabilities: Browse unread RSS entries with all/unread/starred filters
Search, refresh, and paginate entries from a Miniflux server
Open article URLs in Obsidian's Web viewer
Automatically mark opened entries as read
Configure server URL, API key, and page size
extras: Desktop-only. Includes a disclosures section stating that network requests go only to the configured Miniflux server and that the API key is stored locally; no telemetry or self-updates. No usage examples or screenshots.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in RSS reader, so reading feeds from a Miniflux server requires leaving the app.

relations.evidence: Open article URLs in Obsidian Web viewer.

summary: Desktop plugin that reads Miniflux RSS entries in a dedicated view inside Obsidian and opens articles in the core Web viewer.
